BoundKind.description: Direction of inequality for numeric covenants.

oneOf.description: Covenant passes when the metric is less than or equal to the threshold.
Covenant passes when the metric is greater than or equal to the threshold.

DateWire.description: ISO 8601 calendar date encoded as a `YYYY-MM-DD` JSON string.

breach_probability.description: Marginal breach probability at each test date; not a first-passage probability.

breach_probability_stderr.description:
Standard error of the breach probability estimate.

Analytic stochastic probabilities have zero estimator error.

comparator.description: Comparison direction for the covenant threshold test.

first_breach_date.description: Date of first projected breach (if any)

headroom.description:
Headroom (distance from breach) at each test date.

`None` means the covenant is inactive for the period or the headroom is
not meaningful under the applicable covenant convention.

min_headroom_value.description: Minimum finite headroom value across all active test dates.

projected_values.description:
Projected metric values at each test date.

`None` means the covenant is inactive or its earnings denominator makes
the ratio indeterminate. Non-finite caller observations are rejected.

test_dates.description: Future test dates for covenant evaluation

thresholds.description: Covenant thresholds at each test date
